description: External GPU end-to-end validation matrix for loading and quantization roadmap task 8. Entries are plans, not results.

Z-Image.source: .ci/benchmark_configs/z_image.yaml, entry z_image.default, whose tags include gfx950

Z-Image-Turbo.source: .ci/benchmark_configs/z_image_turbo.yaml, entry z_image_turbo.1gpu.rdna4, the only entries this model has. Steps, guidance and resolution describe the model rather than the accelerator, so they carry over to gfx950; guidance is 0.0 because the model is distilled and does not use classifier-free guidance.

FLUX.1-dev.source: .ci/benchmark_configs/flux.yaml, entry flux.usp, whose tags include gfx950

FLUX.2-dev.prompt: Cat astronaut raising a cat flag on the surface of moon
FLUX.2-dev.source: .ci/benchmark_configs/flux2.yaml, entry flux2.t2i_1k, whose tags include gfx950. Text-to-image rather than the image-to-image entries, since these cases pass no input image. The rdna4 entries run the same model at 4 steps, which is a throughput setting rather than this model's operating point.

FLUX.2-klein-9B.prompt: A spectacular sunset over the ocean
FLUX.2-klein-9B.source: .ci/benchmark_configs/flux2_klein.yaml, entry flux2_klein.default, whose tags include gfx950

Qwen-Image.prompt: A cat holding a sign that says hello world

cases.quality_notes: Compare text fidelity and composition against the bf16 case with the same seed.
Confirm the logged Transformers 4 text-encoder fallback is post-load, then compare to the Transformers 5 result.
Verify peer ranks do not independently retain a full host copy of replicated weights.

Inspect both transformer phases; transformer_2 is expected to remain FP8. Unrun, and the success expectation needs checking against the MXFP4 FSDP2 gate: the FP4 half targets transformer.blocks, which the strategy also wraps, so validate_format_fsdp_placement is required and refuses unless torch carries pytorch/pytorch#177948 (2.12). On an older torch expect a preflight_failure instead.
The Qwen3VL text encoder is excluded from quantization; record host transfer behavior.
Compare first/last FP8 override ranges to an all-FP8 reference.
Expected rejection must occur before checkpoint allocation.
Expected rejection must precede reads of the external LightX2V state dicts.
The composition adapter has no standard meta-construction seam.
The manual single-file fallback is intentionally excluded from collective loading.
FSDP cannot safely apply the Transformers 4 text-encoder post-load fallback.
Record the pinned refs/pr/18 transformer load and blockwise fill.
Confirm TorchAO is selected instead of AITER block-scale FP8.
Check native TorchAO text-encoder loading and rank-to-rank output determinism.

Narrowed from non_rdna4_rocm to gfx942: _AITER_FP4_UNSUPPORTED_ARCHS names only gfx942, so this rejection is that arch's behaviour rather than all of non-RDNA4 ROCm. gfx950 accepts FP4 and is covered by rocm-gfx950-flux2-fp4-eager. FLUX.2-dev is a gated repo, so a run needs hub auth; a 401 previously matched the rejection pattern and was mis-scored.

First FP4 success expected on ROCm outside RDNA4. probe_format_backend_capabilities on gfx950 reports aiter_mxfp4 available with no reason, where gfx942 refuses it because AITER compiles no Float4_e2m1fn_x2 kernels for that arch. Predicted from the probe; not yet run.

Replicated meta load does not shard, so the packed MXFP4 weight never reaches FSDP2 and the torch limitation that blocks the fsdp_blockwise case does not apply. Text encoder stays unquantized by declaration.

Still rejected on gfx950, but for the torch version rather than the architecture: MXFP4 packs two 4-bit values into a uint8, and FSDP2 before pytorch/pytorch#177948 (torch 2.12) cannot shard a non-floating-point parameter. This image carries 2.9.1. Krea-2 quantizes transformer.transformer_blocks and wraps the same blocks for FSDP, so the placement check is required and fires. Expect this case to flip to inference_success on a torch 2.12 image.
ROCm INT8 must reject before model allocation.
Compare transformer-only and text-encoder FP8 quality using the same prompt and seed.
Verify minimum-size exclusions and context_refiner exclusion under sequence parallelism.
NVFP4 requires CUDA capability 10.0 or newer.
Verify both transformer components fill and execute under FSDP.
Record transfer overhead and compare output to the non-offloaded INT8 case.
Use a fixed source image and retain it with the result bundle.
Validate the shared transformer construction seam with stage-2 LoRA application.
The LoRA-before-fill ordering is not valid for the FSDP meta path.
Confirm native Diffusers NVFP4 streaming and compare against bf16 and FP8 references.
Text encoder remains unquantized by declaration.

Record whether installed TorchAO tensor subclasses satisfy composable FSDP hooks. Unrun, and as written the code cannot satisfy it: _probe_fsdp_support returns a hardcoded false for nvfp4 with "NVFP4 tensor-subclass FSDP gather/scatter support is not validated", so this rejects on any Blackwell box until that probe is implemented. Keep it as the target, but expect a preflight_failure today.
CUDA NVFP4 has no runtime FP8/FP4 hybrid wrapper.
Record host and device peaks while group offload streams quantized components.
Run with a pre-populated HF_HOME and network disabled; retain the resolved snapshot revision.
Unquantized reference for every other case in this file.
Confirm TorchAO FP8 is selected on gfx942, not AITER block-scale (RDNA4-only).
Native TorchAO text-encoder streaming for the UMT5 encoder; watch for text-conditioning loss.
Memory-efficient FSDP blockwise meta-load across both Wan2.2 transformers; compare peak VRAM against the eager FP8 case.
Control for the ulysses=4 replicated case; the RoPE buffer-dtype corruption survived ulysses<=2.
Rank0 broadcast load at the sequence-parallel degree where buffer-dtype corruption previously produced black output. Inspect the video, not just the exit status.

Same parallel degree as the replicated case but with the ordinary N-rank load, so a pixel diff against mi300x-wan22-i2v-fp8-replicated4 isolates the memory-efficient load from sequence-parallel attention numerics.
Unquantized ulysses-4 reference. Paired with mi300x-wan22-i2v-bf16-replicated4 this isolates the memory-efficient load itself: with no quantization in the way, the two must agree bit for bit.
Rank0 broadcast load with no quantization. Any pixel difference against the eager ulysses-4 control is attributable to the load path alone.
AITER compiles no FP4 kernels for gfx942, so this must be rejected in preflight. Before the gate landed it reached AITER_CHECK(false) after a full model load and died on SIGABRT.
Rejected twice over on this node: no AITER FP4 kernels for gfx942, and torch 2.9.1 FSDP2 cannot shard the uint8 MXFP4 packed parameter. The arch gate fires first.
Unquantized reference for the klein-4B memory-efficient cases; compare composition and text fidelity against them at the same seed.
